title: 厄斐琉斯·月阶静立
description: 厄斐琉斯站在蓝银色月阶上，深蓝发遮住一侧眼睛，月石武器低垂，披衣与银饰构成清晰竖线。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Aphelios is a slender adult Lunari man with pale skin, dark blue hair falling over one eye, a reserved face, and intricate silver lunar ornaments. Preserve his high-collared dark uniform, long coat panels, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. A recognizable moonstone firearm is carried pointed downward beside his leg, while additional weapon forms remain secured and inactive on his equipment harness.
art_direction.scene: Show him standing alone on broad crescent-shaped steps above a quiet lake, head turned slightly toward the open sky. His hands stay composed and the equipment points toward empty stone. Hard moonlike side light defines silver edges and deep indigo wax facets, while two distant pillars and a low horizon give the square a spacious monumental depth.
art_direction.palette: midnight blue, silver, pale moon cream, muted violet
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
